name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain 'tile', descriptor 'blit_24x24_passthrough'. '24x24' is the meaningful sprite dimension (24x24 px tile; confirmed by MOV BL,0x18 = 24 rows and MOV BH,0x18 = 24 cols), not address residue. 'passthrough' accurately distinguishes the no-transform base member from the sibling tint/remap/dim/solid blitters that recolour on top of the same RLE syntax. No Ghidra address residue in name.
purpose: Hand-written RLE blit of a 24x24 sprite into a destination buffer with no palette transform: source bytes are written as-is. Base member of the tile_blit_24x24_* family.
logic_summary: Renders 24 rows; each row starts with x_remain=0x18 columns. Reads one RLE command byte at a time; bits 7..6 select the mode and (low 6 bits)+1 = run length. Mode 00 RUN: paint len pixels from one following source byte contiguously (dst+=len, x-=len). Mode 01 STRIDE-2 RUN: paint len pixels from one following source byte at every other dst byte (INC EDI; STOSB => +2 per pixel, written at odd offset; dst+=2*len, x-=2*len, i.e. SUB BH,CL twice). Mode 10 LITERAL: copy len following source bytes one dst byte each (dst+=len, x-=len). Mode 11 SKIP: advance dst by len with no source consumed (dst+=len, x-=len). When x_remain hits 0 the row ends and dst advances by stride-0x18 to the next row start; 24 rows total. Hand-written asm leaf: no __CHK probe, no CALLs.
signature: void fd2_tile_blit_24x24_passthrough(uint32 src, uint32 dst, uint32 stride)

params.name: src
params.semantics: Pointer (linear address) to the source RLE-encoded 24x24 sprite stream; loaded into ESI and read via LODSB.
params.reason: Accurately names the RLE source stream; no address residue, not generic.

params.name: dst
params.semantics: Destination base linear address; loaded into EDI and written via STOSB / MOVSB.
params.reason: Accurately names the destination base; no address residue, not generic.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Destination row stride in bytes; row advance = stride - 0x18 (MOV EDX,[EBP+0x10]; SUB EDX,0x18). Callers pass 0x1C8 (window-relative helpers) or a caller-supplied stride such as 0x140 (battle-grid/preview composer).
params.reason: Accurately names the destination row stride; no address residue, not generic.

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the in-place blit into the destination buffer.

notes: Disassembly @ 0x4deda confirms the four RLE modes (STOSB.REP RUN; INC EDI+STOSB+LOOP STRIDE-2 RUN; MOVSB.REP LITERAL; ADD EDI,ECX SKIP), BL=24 row counter, BH=0x18 x_remain, row advance EDX=stride-0x18. The src comment block (lines 355-392) and the C body (393-457) already match the asm precisely and are ASCII-clean; no Edit needed (comment kept). The Ghidra plate is consistent with the refined understanding (same four modes, same row tracking, callers list matches the 13 callers), so plate left unchanged. Source body intentionally models the STRIDE-2 store at the odd offset (dst+=1; *dst=pixel; dst+=1) matching INC EDI; STOSB; decompiler's folded 'dst+1; dst+2' is the same +2-per-pixel behavior. 13 callers total.
